docs.text: BerEditor Menu Description File New Open BerEditor in a new window Open Open BER, DER, or PEM files Open Certificate Displays the certificate file in detail. Open CRL Displays the CRL file in detail. Open CSR Displays the CSR file in detail. Open PrivateKey Displays the private key file in detail. Open PublicKey Displays the public key file in detail. Open CMS Displays the CMS file in detail. Save Saves the current BER value. Save As Save the current BER value under a different name. Recent Files Print Print the BER data. Print Preview Preview BER data Edit Copy Information Copy current node information to the clipboard Copy As Hex Copy the current node hex value to the clipboard. Copy As Base64 Copy the current node base64 value to the clipboard. Expand All Expand all tree nodes Expand Node Expand current tree nodes Collapse All Collapse all tree nodes Collapse Node collapse current tree nodes Previous Node Moving from the current node to the previous node Next Node Moving from the current node to the next node Find Finding nodes within BER data View Tool Decode BER Decoding the input BER data Data Convertor Tool for changing character data encoding formats Num Convertor Tool for converting numbers between binary, decimal, and hexadecimal formats. OID Information Information on various representations of OID values Make BER Tool for generating BER data Check BER Function to check the type of BER data Get BER from URI Retrieving BER data using HTTP or LDAP BER Compare Compare two BER data sets to indicate the presence of identical data and differences. Binary View View BER data in binary format. Text View View BER data in tet format. Cryptography Key Manage Generating key derivation and wrapping values, such as KeyDerive, KeyWrap, and KEM. Hash Calculating various digest values, such as SHA Message Authentication Code Generating message authentication code values ​​such as HMAC and CMAC Encrypt/Decrypt Encrypting or decrypting input values ​​or files using a symmetric key Sign/Verify Generate a signature value for an input or file using an asymmetric key, or verify a generated signature value. PubKey Encrypt/Decrypt Performing asymmetric key operations: public key encryption and private key decryption. Key Agreement Obtaining a key agreement value using DH or ECDH PKCS7 Creating signed and encrypted data in PKCS#7 format Shamir Secret Sharing Splitting and merging the key using the Shamir Secret Sharing algorithm Certificate Path Validation Perform path validation for the certificate. OTP Generator Generating a numeric One-Time Password value VID Generating and Verifying Virtual ID Values Used in Joint Certificates BN Calculator Calculator for large numbers Make PrivateKey Generating asymmetric key algorithm public or private key values in BER format. Service KeyPair Manage Providing functions for the use, management, and selection of various asymmetric key pairs. Certificate Manage Provide functions for the use, management, and selection of various certificates and private keys. Key List Provide functions for the use, management, and selection of various symmetric keys. SSL Check Retrieving certificate information used for the SSL/TLS handshake with an HTTPS server. X509 Compare Comparing Certificates, CRLs, and CSR Files for Identity and Differences Document Signer Signing and Verification of CMS, JWS, and XML Documents PDF Signer Signing and Verifying PDF Documents CAVP Generating Results for CAVP Requests Protocol OCSP Client OCSP Client Functionality and Analysis of Request and Response Messages TSP Client TSP Client Functionality and Analysis of Request and Response Messages CMP Client CMP Client Functionality and Analysis of Request and Response Messages SCEP Client SCEP Client Functionality and Analysis of Request and Response Messages ACME Client ACME Client Functionality and Analysis of Request and Response Messages EST Client EST Client Functionality and Analysis of Request and Response Messages KMIP Decode TTLV Decoding the entered KMIP message Make TTLV Generating KMIP messages TTLV Encoder Generating various request commands used in KMIP TTLV Client Sending request messages and receiving response messages as a KMIP client Help Clear Log Clear all log window messages Log Toggle button to start and stop writing log messages. Content View various PKI-related document content. License Information View license information and import and apply license files. Bug or Issue Report Q & A
